appDesc.message: AI generates SEO-optimized Pinterest titles, descriptions, tagged topics & alt text with one-click fill.

step1Desc.message: Go to the Pinterest Create Pin page and open a Pin with an image.

step2Desc.message: Choose a provider, fill in your API Key and model, then tap Test Connection to verify.

step3Desc.message: Click generate to analyze the image, then fill the title and description into Pinterest in one click.

apiStep1Desc.message: Pick SiliconFlow (recommended in China) or OpenAI in the settings above.

apiStep2Desc.message: Sign up on the provider's site and create an API Key.

apiStep3Desc.message: Return here, paste the Key and model, then click Test Connection.
